file_name: M Resources and Golden Energy and Resources – Tahmoor Coal Mine - Questionnaire_0.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if there are not many alternative producers to the Tahmoor, Appin, and/or Dendrobium mines available to one or more domestic customers.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with M Resources, GEAR, GM3,1 and/or Tahmoor.
Do you currently supply metallurgical coal to any domestic customers and, if so, who? Are there any other potential customers you are aware of?
Who do you compete with to supply metallurgical coal to domestic customers?
How do you negotiate prices for the supply of coking coal to customers? What factors are taken into account and do these terms vary for domestic vs export customers?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
